title: Relic AI: AI Second Brain for Links, PDFs & YouTube
excerpt: Relic AI is a free AI second brain. Save links, PDFs, YouTube videos and notes in one click, let AI organize them, and ask questions with cited answers.
content_html:
Relic AI · AI second brainMost tools help you save. Relic helps you remember.

Links. PDFs. Notes. YouTube videos. Instagram posts. LinkedIn posts. They end up scattered across tabs, folders, and apps. Relic brings them together, organizes them automatically, and helps you find and use what you've already learned.

Join beta

Featured in

Your knowledge is everywhere.

Every day you save something useful. An article for later. A video you'll revisit. A PDF for a project. A note with a good idea.

Weeks later, you know you've seen it before, but you can't find it.

Most knowledge isn't lost because you never learned it. It's lost because you can't retrieve it when it matters.

Captures from

Everything you learn from, in one library.

  • arXiv

  • PDFs

  • YouTube

  • Google Drive

  • LinkedIn

  • Notion

  • Web links

How Relic works

Turn saved information into usable knowledge.

Three steps from scattered saves to usable knowledge.

Your knowledge stays yours.

Relic is built with privacy in mind. Your saved content remains under your control and is never used to train external AI models.

Ask your library, not your memory.

Skip the tab-hunting and folder-digging. Ask in plain language, and Relic answers from what you've actually saved, connecting related ideas along the way.

Knowledge that comes back when you need it.

Most valuable information isn't lost because it was never saved. It's lost because it was forgotten. Every week, on the day you pick, your Digest brings back the saves worth reading next, so what you've already found is there when it matters.

Questions

When do I get access?

Right away. The Relic beta is open and free: sign up with your email and your welcome note takes you straight into the app.

What can Relic capture?

Any web link, PDFs and papers (scanned ones too), images and screenshots, YouTube videos (transcribed and summarized for you), Notion pages and Google Drive files, and your browser bookmarks. Save one page with the Chrome extension, a batch of open tabs at once, or import everything and pick exactly what you want.

Where does my data live?

Your library is yours. It's stored encrypted, synced across your devices, and you can export it at any time.

Does it work across platforms?

Relic is a web app plus a Chrome extension that saves the page you're on, or a batch of open tabs, in one click. A mobile app is on the roadmap.

What does it cost?

Relic is free during the beta. Paid plans come later, and you'll always see the price before you're asked to pay anything.

What is an AI second brain?

A place that keeps what you read, watch and save, organizes it for you, and answers questions from it. Relic summarizes and tags every save automatically, then lets you ask your library in plain language and cites the exact sources it used.

How is Relic different from ChatGPT?

ChatGPT knows the internet. Relic knows what you saved. Ask Relic about "that AI article I saved from the New York Times" and it finds it, answers from it, and links the source, because every answer comes only from your own library.

Can Relic transcribe YouTube videos and playlists?

Yes. Save a YouTube video and Relic fetches its transcript, summarizes it, and makes it searchable, so you can ask questions across everything you've watched. Whole playlists can be added too.

Is Relic a good Pocket alternative?

If you used Pocket to save things for later, Relic covers that and goes further: it summarizes what you save, organizes it automatically, and lets you ask questions across all of it, so saved articles don't disappear into a backlog.

Is my data used to train AI?

No. Your library is never used to train AI models, by us or by our AI provider. You can export everything or delete your account at any time.

Relic MCP

Connect your Library to Claude and ChatGPT.

Nothing to install and no key to paste. Add one address to your assistant, sign in to Relic, and choose what it may do. Then ask about your saves, or save and organize, in the conversation you're already having.

  • You choose what it may do
  • No assistant can delete a save
  • Disconnect at any time

When you connect an assistant, the saves it reads are sent to its provider (Anthropic for Claude, OpenAI for ChatGPT), under your own agreement with them.

How connecting works

Never lose the thread again.

The beta is open. Tell us a little about yourself, then create your account in the app.
